name: Sleep Puzzle Resource Guide
description: A read-only guide to Sleep Puzzle's public children's sleep resources, audio programmes, bedtime stories and consultation information. Returns a directory of public links; it does not provide personalised advice, make purchases or book consultations.

skills.name: Discover Sleep Puzzle resources
skills.description: Returns links to the public resource index, articles, audio programmes, bedtime stories and consultation information in Polish and English.
examples: Where can I find Sleep Puzzle's resources?
